text: のうりょくを　さげさせれば　しょうぶも　ゆうりに　なるじゃろう

structure.jp: のうりょくを　さげさせれば
structure.en: if you make its stats drop

structure.jp: しょうぶも　ゆうりに　なるじゃろう
structure.en: the battle will probably turn in your favor

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば after a verb means 'if' this happens, then the next part follows. さげさせれば = 'if you make it lower'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means 'become' something. ゆうりに　なる = 'become advantageous'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: じゃろう is the old-man form of だろう, meaning 'probably'. なるじゃろう = 'it will probably become'.
